name: Slévárna Vrbenský s.r.o.

quality.trend: perfect until 2025Q3; red now only because 2 porosity/burr QNs hit ~24 small lots (jumpy ppm). OTD still best-in-group.

payment_behaviour.note: avg 50.5 days on 45 net; 5.2 days late in last 12m

financial_health.signal: sound; has just invested in a new moulding line

notes: settled below its own ask every time (-5.9, 0.0, -1.7 %)

situation: Czech family foundry that has just doubled its stainless-casting capacity with a new automatic moulding line. It now needs to fill it and calls Hollerau an important reference customer. It is the cheaper HI 80-250 source (559.61 vs Allgäu-Reiter 654.52) but holds only 25 %. It also asked for 10-day payment. Volume and reference value are the currency; it has accepted cuts readily.

pressures.evidence: new line doubles stainless capacity - must be loaded
asked for payment within 10 days against a cash discount
two QNs on small lots turned the rolling ppm red

what_it_values: more volume for the new line

likely_tradeables.give: raise quota from 25 % toward 50 %+ of 1,593 pc/yr
likely_tradeables.get: unit price below 559.61 and lead time <= 56 days
likely_tradeables.why: fills new capacity; we save ~95 EUR/pc vs Allgäu-Reiter on shifted volume

arguments_that_should_land.argument: HI 80-250 forecast 1,593 pc, +13.3 %: we can load your new line.
You are important to us too - we will act as a reference if price and quality hold.
Delivery has been 91.7 % on time - best of our stainless sources.
arguments_that_should_land.why: appreciation; then ask for ppm containment

arguments_to_avoid.why: 2 QNs on tiny lots; KNOWN_ISSUES #10 - read rolling, not lots; would sour a willing partner
AS-14404 is +5.9 % yoy - supports an increase, not a cut
